title: Hồ tĩnh
about: Round x17 (album 12), the user: "hãy sáng tác album tiếp theo": sleep music in the style of Sleep in the Dark (ngu-ngon), on a less common progression of its own (template 1; after the Content ID matches on plain i-VI-iv-V pieces), slow (44 bpm), bowl, waves, pad, sub, an improvised glass tune, then box. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece.
